about: Where the OpenAbstractions runtime is supported, from recorded evidence only. A cross-build is not evidence. scripts/catalogue.py reads this file, checks every evidence path exists, and publishes it in the layer catalogue. A facade on a platform declared unsupported reports runtime_unavailable naming that platform (openabstractions-flat/abstraction-facade/RESOLUTION.md).

statuses.supported: The runtime installs, starts its background services, becomes ready, recovers from a crash and uninstalls, and an application's default resolution reaches it.
statuses.supported without background services: The programs install, run in the foreground and uninstall. No background service is registered, and default resolution finds no runtime.
statuses.unsupported: No application can use a runtime service on this platform. Resolution fails with runtime_unavailable naming the platform.

platforms.name: Windows x64, per-user installation
platforms.runtime: Per-user MSI; the supervisor starts the runtime in the signed-in session.
limits: Installed-client and rollback evidence is revision-specific; consult the selected release for its package qualification.

evidence.shows: Candidate run 35085536304 passed Windows per-user and machine scope; release run 35086256626 passed every job.
Release run 34911872230 ran per-user install, readiness immediately after msiexec, removal and upgrade.
The per-user lifecycle fixture the hosted runs execute.
An elevated install with no scope property is refused before anything is copied (`RefuseElevatedPerUserInstall`, closed in 0.1.7, candidate run 35085536304 and release run 35086256626).

Candidate 5caa1402 (2026-09-17): fresh per-user installation, five-language installed discovery/calls, crash recovery, upgrade from 0.1.7, forced rollback and removal passed. This candidate fixes the earlier failed-upgrade supervisor gap.

platforms.name: Windows x64, machine installation
platforms.runtime: Machine MSI; a service template starts a per-session runtime for each signed-in user.
limits: Removal while a per-session instance runs depends on the Restart Manager (RELEASE-CHECKLIST.md, Windows qualification).

evidence.shows: Candidate run 35085536304 passed Windows machine scope.
Machine installation, fresh-user readiness, crash recovery and uninstall passed on a disposable runner.
Machine-scope fresh-session readiness fixture, run 34908119657.
The machine-scope session fixture.

platforms.name: Linux amd64 with a systemd user manager
platforms.runtime: Per-user tarball; install.sh registers abstraction-runtime.service with the user manager.
limits: Trusted selection needs clone3 and waitid P_PIDFD (Linux 5.4 or newer); a sandbox denying them returns PROOF_UNAVAILABLE.
Measured on WSL2 with systemd 259 only; arm64, other distributions, non-WSL hardware and graphical sessions are untested.

evidence.shows: Install, readiness of five contracts, native selection, untrusted refusal, SIGKILL recovery, reinstall and removal in a temporary account.
One unchanged C++ application passes ten lifecycle scenarios against the installed runtime, including upgrade from the published 0.1.6 package.
Selection requires the loaded user unit, clone3 and pidfd.

platforms.name: Linux amd64 without a systemd user manager (containers, WSL without systemd, hosted CI accounts)
platforms.runtime: The same tarball; install.sh installs the programs, reports that no background service will run and records `timer no`.
limits: Default resolution cannot select a runtime: selection reads the loaded user unit from systemctl, so applications receive runtime_unavailable.
`openabstractions serve runtime` runs in the foreground; an application reaches it only through an explicit endpoint.

evidence.shows: Job linux-verify installs on a hosted runner with no user manager, runs dl, jobd and jobctl against one store, and uninstalls; it passed in release runs 34911872230 and 35086256626.
The no-manager branch.
With no loaded runtime unit, selection returns UNTRUSTED and status reports every contract unresolved.

platforms.name: macOS (universal package)
platforms.runtime: The per-user package installs, upgrades and uninstalls without a password, and launchd runs and restarts the runtime.
limits: Selection has no darwin path, and the platform's peer proof cannot establish the Program identity protected calls require: readiness and resolution are refused.
The recorded direction is XPC with audit tokens (ARCHITECTURE.md, Transport, identity and authority).

evidence.shows: Install, upgrade and crash recovery pass; readiness, resolution and held work are REFUSED-BY-PLATFORM-LIMIT.
Native launchd start, recovery and removal; typed status fails on process proof.
Installed-runtime selection is not implemented outside Windows and Linux.

platforms.name: Android, including Termux
platforms.runtime: None. No runtime is built, packaged, installed or run for Android.
limits: The packager builds only linux and macos; the release builds Windows MSIs, Linux tarballs and one macOS package.
Termux has no systemd user manager, which Linux selection requires.

evidence.shows: `--platform` accepts only linux and macos.
The release builds no Android asset.
Nothing in the tree records a build, install or run on Android or Termux.
